entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gathered in Porte Drazon with Lau..."
entries.dialogueText: I gathered in Porte Drazon with Laurento and the other members of my proposed South Merkopan alliance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For this occasion, I had chosen the..."
entries.dialogueText: For this occasion, I had chosen the Amethyst Room, a circular chamber on one of Palas Rezna's top floors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At its center was a round mahogany..."
entries.dialogueText: At its center was a round mahogany table with sparkling amethyst inlays embedded along its edges. Their violet hue matched the silk drapes lining the walls.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pedestals nestled around the circum..."
entries.dialogueText: Pedestals nestled around the circumference displayed alabaster busts of Queen Lyza and my many other ancestors, dating all the way back to Count Rezna.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ruler upon ruler, each with their o..."
entries.dialogueText: Ruler upon ruler, each with their own approach to diplomacy and conflict. None had attempted an alliance as ambitious as the one I was hoping to realize today.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento and I exchanged nods. It w..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento and I exchanged nods. It was time for the meeting to begin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dear esteemed guests. I thank you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dear esteemed guests. I thank you for joining me today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I, Romus Toras, am honored to begi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I, Romus Toras, am honored to begin this new chapter in Merkopan history with you all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As King of Rizia, I hereby call th..."
entries.dialogueText: "As King of Rizia, I hereby call this meeting to order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us first praise the Lord, with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us first praise the Lord, without whom this great gathering of nations would not be possible."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Halaita!""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others silently bowed their hea..."
entries.dialogueText: The others silently bowed their heads. Laurento cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My tablemates wore proud expression..."
entries.dialogueText: My tablemates wore proud expressions.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I will start with a roll call.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will start with a roll call."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal of Der..."
entries.dialogueText: "Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal of Derdia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal rose and made the hand sign i..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal rose and made the hand sign indicating the six pillars of Wruhecism.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am ready to seal the holy bond t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am ready to seal the holy bond that was written for our countries in the stars."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""President Wiktor Smolak of Wehlen.""
entries.dialogueText: "President Wiktor Smolak of Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak stood and bowed with gusto."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak stood and bowed with gusto.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I am overjoyed to be here with my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am overjoyed to be here with my dear friends and neighbors."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Prime Minister Alma Saltana of Mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Alma Saltana of Morella."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan leader stood up and ga..."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan leader stood up and gave a firm nod.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I look forward to working with you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to working with you all on building a resilient and unified South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Axel Reinhart Toras, Duke of Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "Axel Reinhart Toras, Duke of Pales and Prince Consort of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Axel Reinhart, Duke of Pales and P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Axel Reinhart, Duke of Pales and Prince Consort of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Duke Axel Reinhart of Pales.""
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Axel Reinhart of Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel smiled as he rose from his cha..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel smiled as he rose from his chair.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Thanks to my father-in-law for ext..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to my father-in-law for extending this unique opportunity to us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel smiled as he rose from his cha..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel smiled as he rose from his chair.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""All glory to the King of Rizia for..."
entries.dialogueText: "All glory to the King of Rizia for extending this unique opportunity to us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone sat down."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone sat down.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In a world dominated by ATO and th..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a world dominated by ATO and the CSP, it is vital that that our nations focus on bolstering each other's national security."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In today's every-shifting economic..."
entries.dialogueText: "In today's every-shifting economic climate, establishing financial stability should be of the utmost priority."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oil and gas agreements form the ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oil and gas agreements form the backbone of this alliance. I propose we work further towards establishing energy independence."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As the main initiator of the tenta..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the main initiator of the tentatively titled Intermerkopum Alliance, Rizia is prepared to offer resources to get the project off the ground."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I will let His Majesty explain mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will let His Majesty explain more about our intentions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw nods of agreement around the..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw nods of agreement around the table.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I propose a pooling and sharing of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I propose a pooling and sharing of military assets. Rizia itself shall dedicate a substantial reserve of equipment towards this."
entries.menuText: "I propose a pooling and sharing of military assets. Rizia itself shall dedicate a substantial reserve of equipment towards this." [-5000 Equipment]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom cannot make any concret..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom cannot make any concrete commitments in this arena. But I hope you all recognize the importance of mutual defense."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few of my tablemates looked skept..."
entries.dialogueText: A few of my tablemates looked skeptical. Laurento gestured for me to proceed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Therefore, I pledge to fund our al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, I pledge to fund our alliance on an ongoing basis."
entries.menuText: "Therefore, I pledge that I will fund our alliance on an ongoing basis." [-7 Budget Per Turn]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall contribute a generous sum..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall contribute a generous sum towards the founding of a joint financial reserve."
entries.menuText: "I shall contribute a generous sum towards the founding of a joint financial reserve." [-10 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia itself will not commit any f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia itself will not commit any finances, but my councilors are prepared to aid in the across-the-board coordination of our fiscal policies."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There were a couple of frowns."
entries.dialogueText: There were a couple of frowns.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thereby propose the creation of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thereby propose the creation of a strategic energy stockpile, towards which Rizia is prepared to contribute heavily."
entries.menuText: "I thereby propose the creation of a strategic energy stockpile, towards which Rizia is prepared to contribute heavily." [-8 Energy]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In addition to fulfilling our exis..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition to fulfilling our existing energy contracts, Rizia will make a yearly contribution towards a common energy pool."
entries.menuText: "In addition to fulfilling our existing energy contracts, Rizia will make a yearly contribution towards a common energy pool." [-5 Energy Per Turn]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia cannot promise anything beyo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia cannot promise anything beyond our current energy agreements. But is my hope that we will be able to do so in the future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A bead of sweat appeared on Laurent..."
entries.dialogueText: A bead of sweat appeared on Laurento's forehead.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That is my proposal. I hope that e..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is my proposal. I hope that everyone is on board with it so far."

entries.title: Narrator: "The others exchanged worried looks."
entries.dialogueText: The others exchanged worried looks.

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Mr. Toras... but if you can't make any commitments towards the alliance you yourself are proposing, what makes you think that we will?"

entries.dialogueText: "I am a man of faith. But faith alone cannot sustain an international cooperation of this magnitude."

entries.dialogueText: "I can't say no to family. But I admit the vagueness of it all concerns me."

entries.dialogueText: "I liked this idea in theory. But the vagueness of it all concerns me greatly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others had big smiles on their..."
entries.dialogueText: The others had big smiles on their faces.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Now there's the generosity I was e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now there's the generosity I was expecting from your kingdom."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A promising offer indeed, King Rom..."
entries.dialogueText: "A promising offer indeed, King Romus. I hope it's not a joke."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I can't say no to family anyway. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't say no to family anyway. But I have no qualms about saying yes to what you've offered."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If you can make good on all this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you can make good on all this, my Grand Duchy won't even miss Lespia."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I see the beginnings of a great an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see the beginnings of a great and holy union indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others seemed neither displease..."
entries.dialogueText: The others seemed neither displeased nor particularly impressed.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Now. We have dedicated a portion o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. We have dedicated a portion of today's meeting to go through each nation's individual concerns about this alliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have showed exceptional generosi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have showed exceptional generosity towards each and every one of you individually. Are you trying to bleed me dry?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand your worries. I am op..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your worries. I am open to negotiating with each of you individually to best meet your needs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's go back to my initial propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's go back to my initial proposal. Perhaps I can make a commitment after all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others looked relieved."
entries.dialogueText: The others looked relieved.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are hamstrung by the constraint..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are hamstrung by the constraints of war. Once we have conquered Pales, we will be able to commit all the resources mentioned and then some."

entries.dialogueText: Laurento nodded vigorously in assent.

entries.dialogueText: "We have dedicated a portion of today's meeting to go through each nation's concerns about this alliance."

entries.dialogueText: "With whom should we start?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your reservations are completely u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your reservations are completely understandable. Which is why we have dedicated a portion of this meeting to go through each of your individual concerns."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""In the meantime, we have dedicated..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, we have dedicated a portion of this meeting to go through each of your individual concerns."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "I'm pleased to hear you're all happy with our suggestions."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "Just in case, though, we do have a portion of today's meeting dedicated to going through your individual concerns."

entries.dialogueText: "Supreme Wiseman Azmal, what does Derdia think about the terms for Intermerkopum so far?"

entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak, I'd like to hear Wehlen's opinion."

entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana, what reservations does the Republic of Morella have?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "I must say you have failed to convince me, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: He leaned back in his chair and grinned.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""All I want is a secure future for..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I want is a secure future for my son. We will lay the foundations for that future together."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I was more than satisfied with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was more than satisfied with the outcome of our Zille negotiations. However, I have not yet had the chance to build such a foundation of trust with our neighbors here."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Although thanks to King Romus, Sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although thanks to King Romus, Supreme Wiseman Azmal and I are off to a good start."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked pointedly at Jorga Azmal."
entries.dialogueText: He looked pointedly at Jorga Azmal.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The King talked about energy indep..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King talked about energy independence. But he has not yet brought up Wehlen's oil reserves."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Lord willing, we are.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lord willing, we are."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""In all his talk of cooperation, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "In all his talk of cooperation, the King did not bring up energy."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But I think you all know how much..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I think you all know how much Wehlen has to offer in that regard."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Even after meeting our other trade..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even after meeting our other trade partners' needs, we are more than willing to supply the nations of Intermerkopum with a top-quality product at a good price."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""In the absence of other internatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the absence of other international trade partners, we are more than willing to supply the nations of Intermerkopum with a top-quality product at a bargain price."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Duke of Pales frowned."
entries.dialogueText: The Duke of Pales frowned.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Let's not get carried away. The re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not get carried away. The reserves of the Aureus gas field are more than enough to fuel our little alliance."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Between Wehzek oil and the Aureus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Between Wehzek oil and the Aureus gas field, our alliance is truly overflowing with energy."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Energy is one commodity this allia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Energy is one commodity this alliance could use more of."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Along the lines of what we already..."
entries.dialogueText: "Along the lines of what we already have with Rizia and Derdia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We're talking about oil. Not gas.""
entries.dialogueText: "We're talking about oil. Not gas."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I want your help building a pipeli..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want your help building a pipeline to supply the countries of Intermerkopum with Wehzek petroleum. Starting with Derdia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""All we have to do is figure out wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "All we have to do is figure out where it goes."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I want each of the countries of In..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want each of the countries of Intermerkopum to sign an exclusive oil deal with Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.dialogueText: "Along the lines of what we already have with Rizia."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.dialogueText: "Along the lines of what we already have with Derdia."

entries.dialogueText: "This is a lot to demand, Mr. President. Rizia has its own energy interests to consider."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Wiseman would have to agree to such a project first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You cannot force your oil onto countries that do not need or want it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This could be lucrative for us all..."
entries.dialogueText: "This could be lucrative for us all in the long run."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If there's one lesson I've learned..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's one lesson I've learned from the past two decades of Wehzek history, it's that everyone wants oil."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This is my condition, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is my condition, Your Majesty. I believe the others will find it reasonable."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Azmal nodded.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. You are speaking my language."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal was frowning."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal was frowning.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If Derdia did not have to pay for..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Derdia did not have to pay for such a construction, we would not refuse the energy."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""God has granted us the beginnings..."
entries.dialogueText: "God has granted us the beginnings of an understanding. This will help nurture it."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.dialogueText: "I will only agree to this as long as Palesian gas exports are not affected."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It is your decision, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is your decision, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "How about this. Rizia funds the construction of an oil pipeline from Wehlen to Derdia. We will also grant Pales priority in selling gas to other Intermerkopum nations."
entries.menuText: "How about this. Rizia funds the construction of an oil pipeline from Wehlen to Derdia. We will also grant Pales priority in selling gas to other Intermerkopum nations." [-4 Budget, -2 Energy Per Turn]

entries.dialogueText: "We will help with the oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see nothing wrong with that clau..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see nothing wrong with that clause."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Freeing political prisoners counts..."
entries.dialogueText: "Freeing political prisoners counts for nothing if you keep a muzzle on them. Your citizens should be allowed to express dissent, no matter their history with the law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If that's what it takes for Morell..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's what it takes for Morella to join Intermerkopum, I will strike the clause from my decree."
entries.menuText: "If that's what it takes for Morella to join Intermerkopum, I will strike the clause from my decree." [-1 Authority]

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This is ridiculous, Your Majesty!..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is ridiculous, Your Majesty! You're going to let this woman control how you deal with traitors?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot and will not undermine my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot and will not undermine my own authority, Prime Minister Saltana. The decree will not change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My answer is no. I will not let Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My answer is no. I will not let Morella dictate my country's laws."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I assure you the agreements that a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you the agreements that are made today will stay in place, regardless of who is holding the reins of government."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Now... I know some of you have que..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now... I know some of you have questions about how His Majesty's recent declaration of support for the Rizian reform movement will affect the future of this alliance."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I see the King's willingness to li..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see the King's willingness to listen to his people as a positive sign, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I most certainly do have questions..."
entries.dialogueText: "I most certainly do have questions. About whether a king who'd so easily surrender to reformists' demands will rise to protect his neighbors if the need arises."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is not so much the prospect of..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not so much the prospect of reforms that concerns me as the leader of this movement. If this Sotelato comes to govern Rizia, he will sow the seeds of heathenism across the region."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""As long as His Majesty's promises..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as His Majesty's promises are kept and Derdia's needs are met, the prospect of reform does not concern me."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Your declaration came as a surpris..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your declaration came as a surprise, to be sure, Your Majesty. But my wife fully believes in what you're doing, and she's usually right about these things."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""The declaration threw me for a loo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The declaration threw me for a loop, to be sure. As we've seen, not every Rizian leader is guaranteed to respect Palesian sovereignty."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""As a matter of fact, I have seriou..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I have serious reservations. But I see His Majesty's willingness to listen to his people and implement reforms as a positive sign."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""But I am puzzled that His Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am puzzled that His Majesty appears to be letting these renegades influence his decisions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regimes change. Any of you could b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regimes change. Any of you could be overthrown or voted out tomorrow, and you don't see me throwing away this opportunity because of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see the formation of Intermerkop..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see the formation of Intermerkopum as my last great act as King of Rizia. The people will know how to take it from here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If these reforms pass, I will stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "If these reforms pass, I will still retain a significant amount of influence in government. I will personally ensure that all of Rizia's promises to you are kept."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter our government structure..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter our government structure, Rizia is and will remain a monarchy. Even if I only reign symbolically, my words will still have great weight."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed. And in fact...""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. And in fact..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Ehm... this is true. Member states..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ehm... this is true. Member states of ATO and CSP have gone through leadership changes without adverse effects on the alliance."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But before that happens...""
entries.dialogueText: "But before that happens..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed. None of you have to worry..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. None of you have to worry about unpleasant surprises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The recent disruption aside, I thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The recent disruption aside, I think you'll all agree that my kingdom has proven itself a reliable and generous energy supplier."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unfortunately, our energy stores h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, our energy stores have diminished due to events beyond my control. But it is my hope that they will rebound in time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Various forces have seen fit to cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Various forces have seen fit to cripple our energy supplies in an attempt to force us to depend on oil and gas from faraway shores. But their efforts have been in vain."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""The cornerstone of our alliance is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The cornerstone of our alliance is the PaleStream pipeline. If it doesn't function, then neither do we."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I really must insist that Rizia re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I really must insist that Rizia repair the recent damage immediately. Otherwise..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened his arms wide and gave an..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened his arms wide and gave an exaggerated shrug.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought the cornerstone of our a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought the cornerstone of our alliance was Vina."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I enjoy Her Highness' company dear..."
entries.dialogueText: "I enjoy Her Highness' company dearly. But regional partnerships cannot run on love alone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Forgive the lapse, Your Grace. Of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive the lapse, Your Grace. Of course we'll dedicate the necessary funds towards the pipeline's prompt repair." [-5 Budget]
entries.menuText: "Forgive the lapse, Your Grace. Of course we'll dedicate the necessary funds towards the pipeline's prompt repair."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We lack the funds to repair PaleSt..."
entries.dialogueText: "We lack the funds to repair PaleStream at this time. Once we have the budget, it will be our first priority."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel choked back a laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Axel choked back a laugh.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You'd promise 'Intermerkopum' the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'd promise 'Intermerkopum' the goddamn moon before spending money to repair your own energy grid?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Great.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Otherwise you'll go crawling back..."
entries.dialogueText: "Otherwise you'll go crawling back to Alvarez?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""The time has passed for that, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time has passed for that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I want to remain on good terms wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to remain on good terms with Rizia, for Her Highness' sake. But without PaleStream, Intermerkopum -- and for that matter, reunification -- is not an option for us."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I have one other request, though.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have one other request, though."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Then let's do this, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "Then let's do this, Your Majesty. Pales is in."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You're trying to become the next M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're trying to become the next Merkopan superpower, but you can't even fix your own energy grid?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't threaten me. I will repa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't threaten me. I will repair the damage when I see fit to."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Sorry, Your Majesty, but I just ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Your Majesty, but I just can't take any of this seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Though our nations currently have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though our nations currently have no energy agreements in place, energy independence should be one of this alliance's top goals."

entries.dialogueText: "Our newly established stock exchange will raise capital from across the region, attracting domestic and foreign investments alike."

entries.dialogueText: "I founded the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange with Intermerkopum's long-term success in mind. It will be a key driver of economic integration between our countries."
